title.value: Interactive Language Learning by Question Answering
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Interactive Language Learning by Question Answering

analysis.description: The paper introduces QAit, a novel Machine Reading Comprehension task that focuses on procedural knowledge by requiring an agent to interact with a text-based environment to gather information and answer questions. It proposes a set of baseline models, including deep reinforcement learning agents, to tackle this task.

type.justification: The paper involves experiments and evaluations of models and dataset performances, which is characteristic of empirical research.
type.quote: We propose and evaluate a set of baseline models for the QAit task that includes deep reinforcement learning agents. Experiments show that the task presents a major challenge for machine reading systems, while humans solve it with relative ease.

name.justification: The research is centered around Machine Reading Comprehension, which is a subfield of Natural Language Processing.
name.quote: The dataset and implementation of our baseline agents are publicly available at https://github.com/xingdi-eric-yuan/qait_public.

name.justification: The paper is specifically focused on Machine Reading Comprehension and proposes a novel variation called QAit.
name.quote: The research community has defined the task of machine reading comprehension (MRC) to teach machines to read and understand text.

name.justification: Rainbow is used as a baseline model in the paper, which combines several improvements in deep reinforcement learning.
name.quote: Experiments suggest the dataset presents a major challenge for existing systems, including Rainbow, which set the state of the art on Atari games.

is_contributed.justification: The model is used as a baseline model and not introduced as a novel contribution in the paper.
is_contributed.quote: We evaluate a collection of baseline agents on QAit, including state-of-the-art deep reinforcement learning agents and humans, and discuss limitations of existing approaches.

is_executed.justification: The model was used in experiments and training processes as stated in the paper.
is_executed.quote: Figure 2 shows the training curves for the neural baseline agents when trained using 10 games, 500 games and the 'unlimited' games settings.

is_compared.justification: Rainbow is compared to other methods in the experiments conducted in the paper.
is_compared.quote: We report experimental results by difficulty levels... we use 'DQN', 'DDQN' and 'Rainbow' to indicate QA-DQN trained with vanilla DQN, Double DQN with prioritized experience replay, and Rainbow, respectively.
